tools.name: Paper bomb
tools.use: throw (sticks to surfaces and entities) or tag a kunai
tools.remote: Weave Ram detonates every bomb you placed (weapons rank 3)
tools.trap: placed on the ground it is a mine for 60 s

tools.name: Smoke bomb
tools.effect: smoked: enemies inside lose their target unless sensing; you leave their tracking
tools.escape: dropping one at your feet breaks lock-on

tools.name: Flash bomb
tools.effect: blinded 40 ticks for anyone facing it (yourself too)
tools.counters: genjutsu: a flash breaks genjutsu on allies

modes.tripwire: between two points (a trap that trips, knocks down and triggers tagged bombs)
modes.tether: on a thrown kunai: yank it back with the throw key (and the target, if light)
modes.binding: throw two kunai past a target and pull: bound for 40 ticks (weapons rank 4)
modes.fire_line: a fire user can run a flame down a wire (Dragon Flame)

tools.name: Caltrops
tools.effect: slow 0.4 and 1.0 damage a second to anyone walking (not running on chakra)

tools.name: Sealing tag
tools.effect: stick on a downed or stunned enemy: captured (a quest objective; bosses resist); or on a technique scroll: stores one cast
tools.fuinjutsu: the base of the sealing techniques (four tags make a barrier)

tools.name: Tool pouch
tools.use: quick-throw key (G) throws the selected pouch slot without changing the hotbar; scroll with G held
